currentPublishedItalyTariff.effectiveContext: current Italy direct-kwh-price published by IONITY; July 2026 pricing regime

positiveEvidence: IONITY's current subscriptions data exposes Italy direct-kwh-price=0.85 EUR/kWh and go-kwh-price=0.80 EUR/kWh.
IONITY states Direct/ad-hoc is available without registration and is distinct from subscription/app products.
IONITY's July 2026 pricing communication states new direct/ad-hoc prices apply from 2026-07-01.
negativeEvidence: IONITY explicitly states published prices are current minimum prices and the price at a charging station may be higher.

coverage.reason: 0.85 EUR/kWh is a proven current Italy Direct baseline but IONITY explicitly permits higher station prices; no deterministic station/EVSE mapping proving which IT*IOY EVSE equal the baseline was established in this run.

changes.blockingCondition: Obtain deterministic station/EVSE -> current IONITY Direct price mapping (charger/QR/app/backend/ChargeLeague where applicable), or first-party proof that every current IT*IOY station is exactly 0.85 EUR/kWh.
history: Run 206 pinned the exact current Italy Direct baseline at 0.85 EUR/kWh but deliberately retained fail-closed coverage because IONITY's own disclaimer allows station prices above the published minimum.

coherence.note: This run enriches the existing IOY partial entry without changing nominal partyId counters. Prior run deltas must be merged into the canonical before relying on its headline counters.

next.action: Continue remaining unreconciled network/class-wide candidates; defer IOY station-level mapping until the global/class-wide first pass is exhausted.
